title: George W. Bush considered UFO disclosure with Stephen Hadley

tellings.quote: It's now public knowledge through Hal Putoff that George W. Bush contemplated UFO disclosure with his national security adviser Steven Hadley.

plain: President George W. Bush thought about publicly revealing what the government knows about UFOs, and discussed it with his national security adviser Stephen Hadley. Michels says this is now public knowledge through the physicist Hal Puthoff, a long-time researcher in this field, which would mean a sitting president seriously weighed telling the public.
